function trimTransparent(img,pad=2){const cv=document.createElement('canvas'),cx=cv.getContext('2d');cv.width=img.naturalWidth||img.width;cv.height=img.naturalHeight||img.height;cx.drawImage(img,0,0);let d=cx.getImageData(0,0,cv.width,cv.height).data,minX=cv.width,minY=cv.height,maxX=-1,maxY=-1;for(let y=0;y<cv.height;y++)for(let x=0;x<cv.width;x++){if(d[(y*cv.width+x)*4+3]>8){if(x<minX)minX=x;if(y<minY)minY=y;if(x>maxX)maxX=x;if(y>maxY)maxY=y;}}if(maxX<0)return {src:img.src,bounds:{x:0,y:0,w:cv.width,h:cv.height}};minX=Math.max(0,minX-pad);minY=Math.max(0,minY-pad);maxX=Math.min(cv.width-1,maxX+pad);maxY=Math.min(cv.height-1,maxY+pad);const w=maxX-minX+1,h=maxY-minY+1,out=document.createElement('canvas'),ox=out.getContext('2d');out.width=w;out.height=h;ox.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;ox.drawImage(cv,minX,minY,w,h,0,0,w,h);return {src:out.toDataURL('image/png'),bounds:{x:minX,y:minY,w,h}};}

function composeVanielPortrait(){const left=assets.vaniel_wing_l,right=assets.vaniel_wing_r,body=assets.vaniel_body,base=assets.vaniel;if(body?.naturalWidth&&left?.naturalWidth&&right?.naturalWidth){const cv=document.createElement('canvas'),cx=cv.getContext('2d');cv.width=cv.height=256;cx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;cx.drawImage(left,0,0,256,256);cx.drawImage(right,0,0,256,256);cx.drawImage(body,0,0,256,256);return makeSquarePortrait(cv,{pad:10,focusTop:.54,scale:1.14});}if(base?.naturalWidth)return makeSquarePortrait(base,{pad:10,focusTop:.54,scale:1.14});return null;}

let wakeStartTime=0,wakeDuration=3.95,wakeShowIntro=false,wakeFrame=0,wakeLastFrame=-1;

let doorUnlocked=false,doorOpened=false,doorOpenProgress=0,priantes=[],particles=[],heldKeys=new Set(),visitedCount=0, ambientGain=null, samuelVisits=0, skyBookRead=false, skyQuotesSeen={}, lastHarp=-30, harpIndex=0, glitchEndsAt=0, queuedGlitch=false, nextPrianteSfx=2.2, lastStepMark=0;

const chestOpened=new Set(),chestSeenOnMap=new Set(),portalSeenOnMap=new Set();
const CHEST_EVENT={kind:'chest-event',id:'chest-event',x:spawn.x,y:spawn.y+122,name:'??? · conversar'};

let objs=[];
// Baús encaixados em cantos livres do mapa, longe do trajeto de P.
// Coordenadas em células: canto noroeste, nordeste e sudeste do Limiante.
const CHEST_CORNERS=[[19,3],[61,19],[61,49]];
const CHEST_ITEMS=[
  {id:'chest1',name:'Espelho rachado',asset:'inventory_mirror',line:'Um espelho antigo... o vidro está quebrado. Mesmo assim, acho melhor guardar.'},
  {id:'chest2',name:'Máscara de saco de pão',asset:'inventory_breadmask',line:'Um saco de pão com dois buracos para os olhos. Parece uma máscara improvisada.'},
  {id:'chest3',name:'Mariposa de brinquedo',asset:'inventory_moth',line:'Uma mariposa de brinquedo. Está velhinha, mas parece ter sido muito querida.'}
];
function installChests(){
  const placed=[];
  for(let i=0;i<CHEST_CORNERS.length;i++){
    const [ax,ay]=CHEST_CORNERS[i];
    // Fallback de manutenção se um futuro mapa mudar: canto com passagem livre.
    const corners=[];
    for(let y=3;y<MH-3;y++)for(let x=3;x<MW-3;x++){
      if(map[y][x]!==1 || CONFIG.rooms.some(r=>insideRoom(x,y,r,true)))continue;
      let open=0,walls=0;
      for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){
        if(map[y+dy][x+dx]===1)open++;
        if(map[y+dy][x+dx]===0)walls++;
      }
      if(open<2||walls<1||Math.hypot(x-32,y-48)<8)continue;
      const pos=center(x,y);
      if(placed.some(o=>dist(o,pos)<500))continue;
      corners.push({x,y,rank:(x-ax)**2+(y-ay)**2-0.2*walls});
    }
    corners.sort((a,b)=>a.rank-b.rank);
    if(!corners.length)continue;
    const {x,y}=corners[0];
    const o={kind:'chest',id:'chest'+(i+1),...center(x,y),name:'Baú esculpido',number:i+1};
    placed.push(o);objs.push(o);
  }
  objs.push(CHEST_EVENT);
}
function openChest(o){
  if(chestOpened.has(o.id)){
    showDialogue('P',['Esse baú já está aberto... Não há mais nada aqui.'],'p');return;
  }
  const item=CHEST_ITEMS.find(item=>item.id===o.id);
  chestOpened.add(o.id);chestSeenOnMap.add(o.id);playSound('clue');
  // Apenas um objeto por baú; ele também pode ser visto a qualquer momento com I.
  const lines=[item?'Encontrei: '+item.name+'.':'Encontrei uma coisa estranha...',item?.line||'Vou guardar comigo.'];
  if(chestOpened.size===3){
    chestEventReady=true;
    lines.push('O último baú... Talvez eu devesse voltar ao lugar onde acordei.');
  }
  renderInventory();
  updateHUD();
  showDialogue('P',lines,'p');
}
function luminiSpeaker(){return luminiNameKnown?'Lumini':'???';}
function startLuminiArrival(){
  if(!chestEventReady||luminiArrivalStarted||luminiArrivalFinished)return;
  luminiArrivalStarted=true;luminiArrivalAt=gameTime;
  heldKeys.clear();player.vx=0;player.vy=0;player.moving=false;player.dir='down';
  if(audioCtx&&ambientGain)ambientGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(audioOn?.0017:0,audioCtx.currentTime,.18);
  playSound('clue');
  playSound('success');
}
function luminiEntranceUpdate(){
  if(!luminiArrivalStarted||luminiArrivalFinished||state!=='play')return false;
  const elapsed=gameTime-luminiArrivalAt;
  player.vx=0;player.vy=0;player.moving=false;
  const focusX=CHEST_EVENT.x,focusY=CHEST_EVENT.y-70;
  const cx=clamp(focusX-W/2,0,MW*TILE-W),cy=clamp(focusY-H/2,0,MH*TILE-H);
  camera.x+=(cx-camera.x)*.13;camera.y+=(cy-camera.y)*.13;
  if(elapsed<4.2)return true;
  luminiArrivalFinished=true;
  if(audioCtx&&ambientGain)ambientGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(audioOn?.012:0,audioCtx.currentTime,.35);
  if(!luminiIntroDone){
    luminiIntroDone=true;
    showDialogue('P',[
      'Hã...? Aquele portal... De onde você saiu?',
      'Você... consegue me ver?'
    ],'p',()=>openLuminiIntroduction());
  }
  return true;
}
function openLuminiIntroduction(){
  chestEventExamined=true;
  showDialogue(luminiSpeaker(),[
    'Vejo que voltou... Curioso. Poucos atravessam o Limiante e ainda conservam tantas perguntas.',
    'Se deseja respostas, pequeno Polarium, concederei três. Escolha com cuidado.'
  ],'mysterious_visitor',showLuminiQuestions);
}
function showLuminiQuestions(){
  if(luminiAsked.size>=3){showLuminiFarewell();return;}
  $('lumini-questions-title').textContent=luminiSpeaker();
  $('lumini-questions-screen').setAttribute('aria-label',luminiNameKnown?'Perguntas a Lumini':'Perguntas ao desconhecido');
  $('lumini-questions-status').textContent='Perguntas respondidas: '+luminiAsked.size+' / 3 · Escolha uma pergunta ainda não feita.';
  for(const {key} of LUMINI_QUESTIONS){const b=$('lumini-question-'+key);b.disabled=luminiAsked.has(key);}
  setState('lumini-questions');
}
function askLumini(key){
  if(state!=='lumini-questions'||luminiAsked.has(key))return;
  const question=LUMINI_QUESTIONS.find(q=>q.key===key);
  if(!question)return;
  luminiAsked.add(key);
  // Revela o nome na própria primeira fala da apresentação, nunca antes dela.
  if(key==='name'&&!luminiNameKnown){
    luminiNameKnown=true;CHEST_EVENT.name='Lumini · conversar';updateHUD();
  }
  luminiRevealPending=false;
  showDialogue(luminiSpeaker(),question.lines,'mysterious_visitor',()=>{
    luminiRevealPending=false;
    if(luminiAsked.size===3)showLuminiFarewell();else showLuminiQuestions();
  });
}
function showLuminiFarewell(){

function examineChestEvent(){

let skyRoom=CONFIG.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='ceu');
function insideRoom(x,y,r,outer=false){const p=outer?0:1;return x>=r.x+p&&x<r.x+r.w-p&&y>=r.y+p&&y<r.y+r.h-p;}
function roomAt(px,py){let x=Math.floor(px/TILE), y=Math.floor(py/TILE);return CONFIG.rooms.find(r=>r.id!=='ceu'&&insideRoom(x,y,r,true));}
function getRoomById(id){return CONFIG.rooms.find(r=>r.id===id);}
function carve(x,y,r=1,val=1){for(let yy=y-r;yy<=y+r;yy++)for(let xx=x-r;xx<=x+r;xx++)if(xx>0&&yy>0&&xx<MW-1&&yy<MH-1)map[yy][xx]=val;}
function carveLine(x1,y1,x2,y2,r=1){if(x1===x2){for(let y=Math.min(y1,y2);y<=Math.max(y1,y2);y++)carve(x1,y,r);}else{for(let x=Math.min(x1,x2);x<=Math.max(x1,x2);x++)carve(x,y1,r);}}

function buildMap(){
  const CW=15,CH=12, seen=Array.from({length:CH},()=>Array(CW).fill(false));
  function point(cx,cy){return {x:4+cx*4,y:4+cy*4};}
  let stack=[[7,11]];seen[11][7]=true;carve(32,48,1);
  while(stack.length){let [cx,cy]=stack[stack.length-1], dirs=[[0,-1],[0,1],[-1,0],[1,0]].sort(()=>random()-.5);
    let opt=dirs.map(([dx,dy])=>[cx+dx,cy+dy]).filter(([a,b])=>a>=0&&a<CW&&b>=0&&b<CH&&!seen[b][a]);
    if(!opt.length){stack.pop();continue;}
    let [nx,ny]=opt[Math.floor(random()*opt.length)],a=point(cx,cy),b=point(nx,ny);
    if(a.x===b.x)carveLine(a.x,a.y,b.x,b.y,1);else carveLine(a.x,a.y,b.x,b.y,1);
    seen[ny][nx]=true;stack.push([nx,ny]);
  }
  // Loops: labyrinthine, but the world remains traversable.
  for(let n=0;n<35;n++){let cx=Math.floor(random()*CW),cy=Math.floor(random()*CH),d=random()<.5?[1,0]:[0,1];if(cx+d[0]>=CW||cy+d[1]>=CH)continue;let a=point(cx,cy),b=point(cx+d[0],cy+d[1]);carveLine(a.x,a.y,b.x,b.y,1);}
  // Each room overlays the labyrinth; restore a masonry border and one usable threshold.
  for(const room of CONFIG.rooms){
    for(let y=room.y;y<room.y+room.h;y++)for(let x=room.x;x<room.x+room.w;x++)map[y][x]=insideRoom(x,y,room)?2:0;
    const entryX=room.doorSide==='east'?room.x+room.w-1:room.x;
    for(let y=room.doorY-1;y<=room.doorY+1;y++)for(let d=-1;d<=1;d++){let x=entryX+d;if(map[y]&&x>=0&&x<MW)map[y][x]=2;}
    if(room.doorSide==='east')carveLine(entryX+1,room.doorY,24,room.doorY,1);else carveLine(40,room.doorY,entryX-1,room.doorY,1);
    // Keep golden or themed room threshold without corrupting it.
    for(let y=room.doorY-1;y<=room.doorY+1;y++)if(map[y])map[y][entryX]=2;
  }
  // Central building / gate, connected from its southern entrance.
  for(let y=21;y<=31;y++)for(let x=27;x<=37;x++)map[y][x]=(x===27||x===37||y===21||y===31)?0:3;
  for(let x=31;x<=33;x++)for(let y=30;y<=32;y++)map[y][x]=3;
  carveLine(32,32,32,40,1);
  // Decorative sealed-door face; the keypad is near its right side, inside the entrance chamber.
  map[23][32]=0;map[23][31]=0;map[23][33]=0;
  // Ensure connection between upper and lower portions around central complex.
  carveLine(24,19,24,35,1);carveLine(40,19,40,35,1);
  // Passagem até a antecâmara quadrada 1; o portal está no centro da sala.
  carveLine(40,12,45,12,1);
  // Player spawn and initial clearing.
  carve(32,48,2);
  // Safety: exact entry tiles inside rooms.
  for(const r of CONFIG.rooms){if(r.id==='ceu')continue;if(r.doorSide==='east')carveLine(r.x+r.w,r.doorY,22,r.doorY,1);else carveLine(42,r.doorY,r.x-1,r.doorY,1);}
}
function fill(c,fillStyle,x,y,w,h){c.fillStyle=fillStyle;c.fillRect(Math.floor(x),Math.floor(y),Math.ceil(w),Math.ceil(h));}
function line(c,color,x1,y1,x2,y2,thick=1){c.strokeStyle=color;c.lineWidth=thick;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(Math.floor(x1)+.5,Math.floor(y1)+.5);c.lineTo(Math.floor(x2)+.5,Math.floor(y2)+.5);c.stroke();}
function pixelLine(c,color,points,width=2){c.strokeStyle=color;c.lineWidth=width;c.lineCap='square';c.lineJoin='miter';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(Math.round(points[0][0]),Math.round(points[0][1]));for(const [x,y] of points.slice(1))c.lineTo(Math.round(x),Math.round(y));c.stroke();}
function masonryTile(x,y){
  const bx=x*TILE,by=y*TILE,h=hash(x,y),top=map[y-1]?.[x]===0,bottom=map[y+1]?.[x]>0,left=map[y]?.[x-1]>0,right=map[y]?.[x+1]>0;
  // Deep wall: two clearly different material planes, relief, masonry seams.
  fill(mc,h>.5?'#302b33':'#28232b',bx,by,40,40);
  fill(mc,'#1b171f',bx,by,40,3);
  let shift=(y%2)*16;
  for(let j=0;j<2;j++){
    let sy=by+j*20+2;
    fill(mc,j===0?'#39323c':'#322a34',bx,sy,39,16);
    fill(mc,'#59454e',bx+2,sy+1,34,2);
    fill(mc,'#1b161d',bx,sy+16,40,3);
    for(let k=-1;k<=2;k++){let xx=bx+k*22+(j?shift:22-shift);if(xx>=bx&&xx<bx+39)fill(mc,'#17131b',xx,sy+2,2,14);}
  }
  if(h>.63){fill(mc,'#68585c',bx+5,by+8,9,2);fill(mc,'#42353e',bx+22,by+25,11,3);}
  if(hash(x,y,71)>.79)pixelLine(mc,'#19131b',[[bx+11,by+4],[bx+13,by+12],[bx+8,by+15],[bx+19,by+28],[bx+17,by+37]],2);
  // Roots creep between fractures and hang over the lip.
  if(hash(x,y,23)>.54){let sx=bx+hash(x,y,28)*33;pixelLine(mc,'#44382e',[[sx,by],[sx+5,by+10],[sx+2,by+20],[sx+12,by+32]],3);pixelLine(mc,'#725942',[[sx,by],[sx+5,by+10],[sx+2,by+20]],1);if(h>.78)pixelLine(mc,'#473a30',[[sx+5,by+10],[sx+18,by+15],[sx+23,by+19]],2);}
  // Extruded face along the walkable edge: unmistakable wall/floor boundary.
  if(bottom){fill(mc,'#0d0a12',bx,by+27,40,13);fill(mc,'#514148',bx,by+19,40,4);fill(mc,'#87717b',bx,by+19,40,2);fill(mc,'#362831',bx,by+23,40,4);fill(mc,'#19121b',bx,by+34,40,4);if(h>.6)fill(mc,'#5f4b4e',bx+12,by+28,11,2);}
  if(left){fill(mc,'#100c13',bx,by,6,40);fill(mc,'#6e535b',bx+6,by+4,2,30);}
  if(right){fill(mc,'#130e17',bx+34,by,6,40);fill(mc,'#6e5158',bx+32,by+4,2,28);}
  if(hash(x,y,502)>.925){
    // Disjoint, half-erased inscriptions: debris of cultures Limiante has already consumed.
    const ix=bx+8+Math.floor(hash(x,y,501)*16),iy=by+10;
    pixelLine(mc,'#806870',[[ix,iy],[ix+5,iy+2],[ix+2,iy+9]],1);
    fill(mc,'#654f58',ix+7,iy+6,3,1);
  }
  if(!top)fill(mc,'#705961',bx+5,by+1,29,3);
}
function skyBoundaryTile(x,y){
  const bx=x*TILE,by=y*TILE,h=hash(x,y,97);
  // Heaven is a suspended open-air platform: luminous balustrades, not dark brick walls.
  fill(mc,'#725637',bx,by,40,40);

  fill(mc,'#f6da99',bx+3,by+3,34,5);

  fill(mc,'#fff1c1',bx+4,by+2,30,2);
  fill(mc,'#39281c',bx,by+36,40,4);
  if(h>.62){fill(mc,'#fef0c2',bx+5,by+20,12,3);fill(mc,'#ffe2a9',bx+2,by+23,23,4);}

function floorTile(x,y,t){
  const bx=x*TILE,by=y*TILE,h=hash(x,y),ri=CONFIG.rooms.find(r=>insideRoom(x,y,r,true)),sky=ri?.id==='ceu';
  let pal=sky?['#45424c','#55515c','#4d4953','#5d5661']:
    ri?.id==='arquivo'?['#252e34','#2b3a3e','#313f3f','#29333b']:
    ri?.id==='relicario'?['#58616b','#68707a','#59636e','#727b83']:
    t===3?['#473c43','#41323d','#4d3a41','#45333b']:
    ['#42343e','#493942','#4b3c43','#3d313b'];
  let base=pal[Math.min(3,Math.floor(h*4))];fill(mc,base,bx,by,40,40);
  if(sky){
    // Entrada 1: placas frias e gastas como nos outros acessos do Limiante.
    fill(mc,'#18161e',bx+1,by+1,38,3);fill(mc,'#8a7b83',bx+3,by+34,34,2);
    fill(mc,'#2c2631',bx+37,by+4,2,29);
    if(h>.58)pixelLine(mc,'#39323c',[[bx+7,by+9],[bx+17,by+16],[bx+15,by+26]],2);
    if(hash(x,y,93)>.76)fill(mc,'#a58b78',bx+11,by+27,8,2);
    return;
  }
  // Distinct cracked paving slabs, not the same texture as vertical masonry.
  fill(mc,'#19151d',bx+1,by+1,38,2);fill(mc,'#715763',bx+4,by+35,33,2);fill(mc,'#291f2b',bx+37,by+4,2,27);
  fill(mc,'#68525d',bx+5,by+5,13,2);fill(mc,'#5b4652',bx+23,by+18,10,2);
  if(h>.53)pixelLine(mc,'#271e29',[[bx+7,by+13],[bx+17,by+18],[bx+14,by+28],[bx+25,by+32]],2);
  if(hash(x,y,39)>.79){fill(mc,'#1c1c20',bx+7,by+28,8,4);fill(mc,'#83716b',bx+10,by+25,4,2);}
  if(hash(x,y,13)>.87){fill(mc,'#6c654d',bx+6,by+10,2,9);fill(mc,'#847a54',bx+9,by+14,3,6);fill(mc,'#362b31',bx+8,by+7,6,3);}
  if(hash(x,y,424)>.955){
    // Small areas of lost mosaic: traces, not clickable clues.
    const cx=bx+12,cy=by+16;
    pixelLine(mc,'#8d7073',[[cx-3,cy],[cx+4,cy-6],[cx+10,cy],[cx+4,cy+6],[cx-3,cy]],1);
    fill(mc,'#312631',cx+4,cy-1,2,3);
  }
  // root runners crossing flagstone floor
  if(hash(x,y,14)>.89){pixelLine(mc,'#42342c',[[bx,by+32],[bx+13,by+27],[bx+24,by+33],[bx+39,by+22]],3);pixelLine(mc,'#725843',[[bx+4,by+31],[bx+15,by+28],[bx+29,by+31]],1);}
}
function drawColumn(c,x,y,gold=false){let a=x*TILE,b=y*TILE;fill(c,'#141014',a+7,b+26,26,10);fill(c,gold?'#9c7e4e':'#58434a',a+9,b-4,22,31);fill(c,gold?'#dfc68a':'#74585a',a+6,b-5,28,7);fill(c,gold?'#675133':'#3a2d34',a+10,b+13,3,13);fill(c,gold?'#c0a36d':'#403239',a+10,b+5,4,13);fill(c,gold?'#3e352c':'#201922',a+5,b+25,30,8);}
function drawImageCover(c,img,dx,dy,dw,dh,zoom=1.0){
  if(!img?.naturalWidth)return;
  const sw0=img.naturalWidth, sh0=img.naturalHeight, dr=dw/dh, sr=sw0/sh0;
  let sx=0, sy=0, sw=sw0, sh=sh0;
  if(sr>dr){ sw=sh0*dr; sx=(sw0-sw)/2; }
  else { sh=sw0/dr; sy=(sh0-sh)/2; }
  const z=Math.max(1,zoom);
  const zw=sw/z, zh=sh/z;
  sx += (sw-zw)/2; sy += (sh-zh)/2; sw=zw; sh=zh;
  c.drawImage(img,sx,sy,sw,sh,dx,dy,dw,dh);
}
function renderTerrain(){
  mc.clearRect(0,0,mapCanvas.width,mapCanvas.height);
  for(let y=0;y<MH;y++)for(let x=0;x<MW;x++){if(map[y][x]===0){masonryTile(x,y);}else floorTile(x,y,map[y][x]);}
  for(let y=3;y<MH-2;y++)for(let x=3;x<MW-2;x++){
    if(map[y][x]!==0)continue;
    if(map[y+1][x]>0&&hash(x,y,72)>.935)drawColumn(mc,x,y,false);
  }
  // Broken architectural remnants, loose stone and roots across the maze.
  for(let y=2;y<MH-2;y++)for(let x=2;x<MW-2;x++){
    if(map[y][x]!==1 || CONFIG.rooms.some(r=>insideRoom(x,y,r,true)))continue;
    let r=hash(x,y,816),bx=x*TILE,by=y*TILE;
    if(r>.966){fill(mc,'#1c151c',bx+7,by+18,26,12);fill(mc,'#62505b',bx+10,by+16,20,5);fill(mc,'#7d6564',bx+15,by+14,12,2);fill(mc,'#3a2b35',bx+6,by+27,29,5);}
    else if(r>.92){pixelLine(mc,'#342b29',[[bx-8,by+7],[bx+9,by+22],[bx+26,by+18],[bx+39,by+30]],4);pixelLine(mc,'#6e5846',[[bx-6,by+8],[bx+9,by+21],[bx+26,by+18]],2);}
    if(hash(x,y,812)>.958){fill(mc,'#988676',bx+10,by+13,4,2);fill(mc,'#63535b',bx+22,by+22,5,3);fill(mc,'#2a202a',bx+5,by+29,8,3);}
  }
  // A primeira memória agora usa uma arte externa carregada por renderScene1().
  drawRoomDetails(mc);
}
function drawRoomDetails(c){
  // The second memory is held by a pale marble threshold and a stone arch marked TWO.
  const r=getRoomById('relicario');for(const [x,y] of [[5,7],[16,7],[5,15],[16,15]])drawColumn(c,x,y);
  let p=center(10,10);fill(c,'#10131b',p.x-88,p.y+16,176,19);fill(c,'#79828a',p.x-81,p.y-11,164,34);fill(c,'#d6d6d3',p.x-72,p.y-11,148,5);
  for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++){let bx=p.x+k*26;fill(c,'#bfc1c2',bx,p.y+17,21,3);}
  c.strokeStyle='#eee0d7';c.lineWidth=4;c.beginPath();c.arc(p.x,p.y-31,46,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
  fill(c,'#24171a',p.x-31,p.y-41,62,38);fill(c,'#cfb8ad',p.x-29,p.y-39,58,3);
  c.font='bold 26px Georgia';c.fillStyle='#fae4d7';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText('2',p.x,p.y-13);c.textAlign='left';
  // Flooded archive: desks, ruined shelves and water outlines.
  const a=getRoomById('arquivo');for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    let xx=(a.x+2+i*4)*TILE,yy=(a.y+2)*TILE;fill(c,'#172024',xx,yy,76,18);fill(c,'#52423f',xx+3,yy-6,68,10);
    for(let j=0;j<6;j++)fill(c,j%2?'#76644e':'#3b4544',xx+8+j*9,yy-12,5,11);
  }
  for(let i=0;i<28;i++){let xx=(a.x+2+hash(i,2)*12)*TILE,yy=(a.y+5+hash(i,8)*7)*TILE;line(c,'#485b5b',xx,yy,xx+11,yy,1);}
  // Primeira antecâmara — 16×16 células: quadrado de pedra semelhante às demais salas.
  // Não há anjos/objetos da memória aqui; eles permanecem exclusivamente no mapa lunar.
  const sq=getRoomById('ceu'),sx=(sq.x+1)*TILE,sy=(sq.y+1)*TILE,sw=(sq.w-2)*TILE,sh=(sq.h-2)*TILE;
  c.save();
  c.strokeStyle='#a49498';c.lineWidth=5;c.strokeRect(sx+8,sy+8,sw-16,sh-16);
  c.strokeStyle='#392d3b';c.lineWidth=9;c.strokeRect(sx+18,sy+18,sw-36,sh-36);
  c.strokeStyle='#6a5965';c.lineWidth=2;c.strokeRect(sx+27,sy+27,sw-54,sh-54);
  // A faixa oeste é a passagem do corredor; o revestimento não a fecha.
  fill(c,'#45414b',sx+3,center(46,12).y-58,43,118);
  for(const [ox,oy] of [[sx+40,sy+40],[sx+sw-40,sy+40],[sx+40,sy+sh-40],[sx+sw-40,sy+sh-40]]){
    fill(c,'#211b25',ox-17,oy-12,34,31);
    fill(c,'#887783',ox-19,oy-17,38,9);
    fill(c,'#594b56',ox-14,oy-27,28,13);
    fill(c,'#aa969a',ox-14,oy-27,28,4);
  }
  const pc=center(54,11);
  fill(c,'#181319',pc.x-96,pc.y+29,192,25);
  fill(c,'#6b6770',pc.x-92,pc.y+24,184,12);
  fill(c,'#b5aeb3',pc.x-83,pc.y+24,166,4);
  for(let k=-3;k<=3;k++)fill(c,'#56515d',pc.x+k*24-10,pc.y+39,20,3);
  c.restore();
  // Gate hall approach flooring and dramatic etched masonry.
  for(let x=29;x<=35;x++){let xx=x*TILE, yy=22*TILE;fill(c,'#160f17',xx,yy,39,12);fill(c,'#6f5258',xx+2,yy+3,36,2);}

}

function tx(x){return x-camera.x;}function ty(y){return y-camera.y;}
function drawSprite(name,x,y,scale=78,dir='down',bob=0){let img=assets[name];if(!img?.complete||!img.naturalWidth)return;
  let xx=tx(x), yy=ty(y), left=xx-scale/2, top=yy-scale*.90+bob;
  g.save();g.translate(Math.round(left),Math.round(top));
  if(dir==='right'){g.translate(scale,0);g.scale(-1,1);}if(dir==='up')g.filter='brightness(.67)';
  g.drawImage(img,0,0,scale,scale);g.restore();
}
// Layered 2D animation: the original wing pixels move independently behind the torso.
function drawAngelSprite(o,scale,bob){
  // Teste 24: imagem frontal aprovada, recorte transparente, sem painéis escuros.
  // As quatro identidades e os retratos de diálogo continuam os mesmos.
  const newToken=assets['angel2_'+o.id];
  if(newToken?.naturalWidth){
    const size=o.id==='vaniel'?116:110;
    const x=tx(o.x),y=ty(o.y);
    g.save();g.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    g.translate(Math.round(x),Math.round(y)+Math.round(bob));
    g.rotate(Math.sin(gameTime*.58+o.x*.004)*.005);
    g.drawImage(newToken,-Math.round(size/2),-Math.round(size*.93),size,size);
    g.restore();return;
  }
  const x=tx(o.x),y=ty(o.y),left=Math.round(x-scale/2),top=Math.round(y-scale*.90+bob);
  const leftWing=assets[o.id+'_wing_l'],rightWing=assets[o.id+'_wing_r'],body=assets[o.id+'_body'];
  const flap=Math.sin(gameTime*(o.id==='vaniel'?.85:1.18)+o.x*.011);
  if(body?.naturalWidth&&leftWing?.naturalWidth&&rightWing?.naturalWidth){
    function part(img,pivotX,pivotY,angle,spread=1){
      g.save();
      g.translate(left+pivotX*scale/256,top+pivotY*scale/256);
      g.rotate(angle);
      g.scale(spread,1);
      g.drawImage(img,-pivotX*scale/256,-pivotY*scale/256,scale,scale);
      g.restore();
    }
    // Wings fan open beyond the shoulders instead of ending against the torso.
    // Their animation stays behind the body, retaining the original pixel art.
    const fan=o.id==='vaniel'?1.34:1;
    part(leftWing,97,121,flap*.065-.03,fan);
    part(rightWing,161,120,-flap*.065+.03,fan);
    g.drawImage(body,left,top,scale,scale);
    if(o.id==='vaniel'){
      const mx=Math.round(left+scale*.50), my=Math.round(top+scale*.30);
      fill(g,'#d87c8e',mx-4,my,2,1); fill(g,'#d87c8e',mx+2,my,2,1);
      fill(g,'#d87c8e',mx-2,my+1,4,1);
      fill(g,'rgba(255,214,226,.65)',mx-3,my-1,1,1); fill(g,'rgba(255,214,226,.65)',mx+2,my-1,1,1);
    }
  }else{
    // Akiriel keeps his original hooded sprite; remove the drawn-on oversized wings.
    drawSprite(o.id,o.x,o.y,scale,'down',bob);
  }
}

// TESTE 61 — movimento com passos reais e contato do pé no solo.
// Conserva os atlas e a identidade gráfica do Teste 59. A parte inferior de
// cada quadro move-se em oposição (passo e contrapeso), sem deslizar imóvel.
const P_RENDER_SIZE=78;
const P_ANIMATION_FRAMES={idle:6,walk:8,run:12};
function drawAnimatedP(x,y,size,dir,bob=0){
  const mode=player.moving?(player.sprinting?'run':'walk'):'idle';
  const img=assets['p_'+mode],frames=P_ANIMATION_FRAMES[mode];
  if(!img?.naturalWidth){drawSprite('p',x,y,size,dir,bob);return;}
  const i=mode==='idle'?Math.floor(gameTime*5.6)%frames:Math.floor(player.step*(mode==='run'?1.08:.97))%frames;
  const speed=player.moveBlend||0;
  const phase=(i/frames)*Math.PI*2;
  const sway=mode==='idle'?Math.sin(gameTime*2.15)*.34:Math.cos(phase*2)*(mode==='run'?1.8:.9)*speed;
  const tilt=clamp(player.lean||0,-.039,.039)*speed+(mode==='idle'?Math.sin(gameTime*.83)*.002:Math.sin(phase)*.013*speed);
  const xx=tx(x),yy=ty(y),left=-size/2,top=-size*.9+bob;
  g.save();g.translate(xx,yy+sway);g.rotate(tilt);g.translate(left,top);
  if(dir==='right'){g.translate(size,0);g.scale(-1,1);}
  if(dir==='up')g.filter='brightness(.77) saturate(.88)';
  g.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  const sx=i*256;
  if(mode==='idle'||speed<.10){
    g.drawImage(img,sx,0,256,256,0,0,size,size);
  }else{
    // Tronco e capuz permanecem inteiros. As duas pernas possuem passadas opostas.
    const seam=203,step=mode==='run'?18:12,up=mode==='run'?11:8;
    const unit=size/256;
    g.drawImage(img,sx,0,256,seam,0,0,size,seam*unit);
    for(let foot=0;foot<2;foot++){
      const cycle=phase+(foot?Math.PI:0);
      const offset=Math.sin(cycle)*step*speed*unit;
      const lift=Math.max(0,Math.cos(cycle))*up*speed*unit;
      const sourceX=sx+foot*128;
      g.drawImage(img,sourceX,seam,128,256-seam,
        foot*size/2+offset, seam*unit-lift, size/2,size-seam*unit);
    }
  }
  g.restore();
}
function halo(x,y,r,color,a=.5){let xx=tx(x),yy=ty(y),v=g.createRadialGradient(xx,yy,0,xx,yy,r);v.addColorStop(0,color);v.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');g.save();g.globalAlpha=a;g.globalCompositeOperation='screen';g.fillStyle=v;g.fillRect(xx-r,yy-r,2*r,2*r);g.restore();}
function drawWorldGate(x,y){
  const open=clamp(doorOpenProgress,0,1), smooth=open*open*(3-2*open), spread=Math.round(86*smooth);
  const pulse=.5+.5*Math.sin(gameTime*2.3);

  fill(g,'#08070b',x-151,y-221,302,234);
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
    let xx=x-142+i*46;
    fill(g,i%2?'#322631':'#3c2a38',xx,y-198,43,207);
    fill(g,'#80616a',xx+3,y-195,4,194);
    fill(g,'#130d15',xx+38,y-192,5,203);
    for(let j=0;j<7;j++)fill(g,'#644b55',xx+8,y-175+j*23,28,2);
  }
  // Lintel, keystone, eroded inscribed borders.
  fill(g,'#362631',x-149,y-225,299,42);
  fill(g,'#99787a',x-145,y-222,289,5);
  fill(g,'#211720',x-150,y-190,300,8);
  for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
    let xx=x-139+i*34;
    fill(g,'#70535b',xx,y-218,4,27);
    fill(g,'#b08a7d',xx+1,y-216,2,16);
  }
  fill(g,'#100c13',x-118,y-178,237,185);
  fill(g,'#76606b',x-128,y-194,14,209);
  fill(g,'#76606b',x+114,y-194,14,209);
  fill(g,'#a18487',x-126,y-192,3,195);
  fill(g,'#a18487',x+119,y-192,3,195);
  // Beyond the leaves is a real opening, not a clickable win condition.
  fill(g,'#05060a',x-106,y-167,210,171);
  if(open>.015){
    g.save();g.globalAlpha=.17+open*.38;
    halo(x+camera.x,y+camera.y-87,110,'rgba(214,156,112,.75)',.26+open*.12);
    fill(g,'#251b23',x-77,y-156,156,149);
    for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
      let xx=x-72+i*13;
      fill(g,'#372c34',xx,y-140,2,124);
      fill(g,'#ae795e',xx+4,y-155+(i%4)*21,2,3);
    }
    // A deep corridor subtly recedes through the stone.
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
      let inset=i*13;
      g.strokeStyle=`rgba(167,124,101,${.3-i*.045})`;g.lineWidth=2;
      g.strokeRect(x-82+inset,y-155+inset/2,165-inset*2,148-inset);
    }
    g.restore();
  }
  // Two separate physical door leaves that visibly withdraw into the stone.
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    const bx=side<0?x-100-spread:x+1+spread, bw=99;
    fill(g,'#231b22',bx,y-166,bw,171);
    fill(g,'#4f3944',bx+4,y-164,bw-8,164);
    fill(g,'#291e28',bx+10,y-156,bw-20,152);
    fill(g,'#8b6c6d',bx+12,y-155,6,150);
    fill(g,'#17121c',bx+bw-18,y-158,7,155);
    for(let j=0;j<8;j++){
      let yy=y-148+j*19;
      fill(g,'#b49683',bx+19,yy,bw-35,3);
      fill(g,'#38252e',bx+20,yy+4,bw-35,4);
      fill(g,'#d2b58b',bx+25,yy+2,6,2);
    }
    // Recessed spiritual seal on each individual slab.
    g.strokeStyle=doorUnlocked?'#e2c38b':'#9b6070';g.lineWidth=3;
    g.beginPath();g.arc(bx+(side<0?69:30),y-104,23,0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();
    let sx=bx+(side<0?68:30);
    pixelLine(g,doorUnlocked?'#e9d6a5':'#b07783',[[sx,y-131],[sx,y-75]],3);
    pixelLine(g,doorUnlocked?'#e9d6a5':'#b07783',[[sx-14,y-104],[sx+14,y-104]],3);
    fill(g,'#d0b393',bx+(side<0?91:5),y-144,3,137);
  }
  // The lintel and iron rails always remain immobile.
  fill(g,'#1a121c',x-121,y-181,242,11);
  fill(g,'#988078',x-112,y-181,224,3);
  fill(g,'#120d13',x-147,y+3,291,15);
  fill(g,'#9b7974',x-137,y+3,274,4);
  for(let xx of [-108,108])for(let j=0;j<7;j++)fill(g,'#a1817a',x+xx,y-159+j*24,4,7);
  pixelLine(g,'#3e2d24',[[x-147,y-209],[x-134,y-152],[x-138,y-93],[x-118,y-39]],6);
  pixelLine(g,'#77553f',[[x-148,y-208],[x-134,y-153],[x-138,y-95]],2);
  pixelLine(g,'#493227',[[x+147,y-219],[x+135,y-156],[x+139,y-115],[x+120,y-52]],6);
  // Industrial numerical keypad is deliberately exposed ON the ancient frame.
  drawPhysicalKeypad(x+117,y-40);
  if(doorUnlocked){
    let count=2+Math.floor(smooth*6);
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
      let fx=x-62+((i*47)%124),fy=y-116+((i*29)%105);
      g.globalAlpha=(.2+smooth*.6)*(.65+.35*Math.sin(gameTime*2+i));
      fill(g,'#edcb96',fx,fy,2,2);
    }
    g.globalAlpha=1;
    halo(x+camera.x,y+camera.y-91,145,'rgba(236,194,115,.8)',.18+smooth*.27);
  }
  // Mechanical vibration while opening.
  if(open>.03&&open<.99){
    g.globalAlpha=.12*pulse;
    fill(g,'#f9dcba',x-96-spread,y-2,191+spread*2,2);
    g.globalAlpha=1;
  }
}
function drawPhysicalKeypad(x,y){
  // Pixel-built exposed antique-modern device: ceramic buttons and phosphor green display.
  const glow=doorUnlocked?'#b0ffc6':'#9fcbb7';
  g.save();
  g.translate(x,y);
  g.scale(.52,.52);
  g.translate(-x,-y);
  fill(g,'#090b0d',x-31,y-54,63,83);
  fill(g,'#252a2a',x-29,y-52,59,79);
  fill(g,'#a49f91',x-30,y-53,59,4);
  fill(g,'#70746f',x-27,y-49,54,72);
  fill(g,'#272c2b',x-25,y-46,50,68);
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++)fill(g,'#a9a496',x-22+i*13,y-47,10,2);
  fill(g,'#0b1818',x-22,y-42,44,24);
  fill(g,'#83ac9a',x-19,y-39,38,18);
  fill(g,'#152b23',x-17,y-37,34,14);
  fill(g,doorUnlocked?'#7af4a7':'#a1c6a3',x-14,y-32,29,3);
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++)fill(g,glow,x-12+i*8,y-26,4,2);
  const symbols=['1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9','*','0','#'];
  // Bitmap 3x5, visibly pixelated digits at environmental scale.
  const font={'0':['111','101','101','101','111'],'1':['010','110','010','010','111'],'2':['111','001','111','100','111'],'3':['111','001','111','001','111'],'4':['101','101','111','001','001'],'5':['111','100','111','001','111'],'6':['111','100','111','101','111'],'7':['111','001','010','010','010'],'8':['111','101','111','101','111'],'9':['111','101','111','001','111'],'*':['101','010','111','010','101'],'#':['101','111','101','111','101']};
  for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
    let xx=x-20+(i%3)*14, yy=y-13+Math.floor(i/3)*12;
    fill(g,'#0d1114',xx-2,yy-2,12,11);
    fill(g,'#a3a398',xx-1,yy-1,10,9);
    fill(g,'#ddd5bd',xx-1,yy-1,9,7);
    const rows=font[symbols[i]];
    for(let a=0;a<5;a++)for(let b=0;b<3;b++)if(rows[a][b]==='1')fill(g,'#303e38',xx+b*2,yy+a,2,1);
  }
  for(const a of [-1,1])for(const b of [-1,1])fill(g,'#111819',x+a*24-2,y-14+b*31,4,4);
  fill(g,doorUnlocked?'#5dffa5':'#d25c5b',x+20,y-45,4,4);
  fill(g,'#191c1d',x-30,y+23,61,6);
  halo(x+camera.x,y+camera.y-31,23,doorUnlocked?'rgba(91,255,174,.5)':'rgba(128,181,148,.38)',.20);
  g.restore();
}

      for(let ring=0;ring<4;ring++){

        g.beginPath();g.ellipse(cx,cy,22+portalRing*(19+ring*9)+ring*5,41+portalRing*(12+ring*8)+ring*4,.03*Math.sin(gameTime*3.8+ring),0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();
      }

      g.fillStyle='rgba(11,6,16,.60)';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x,y-2,26*manifest,7,0,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();
      if(img?.naturalWidth){g.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;g.drawImage(img,Math.round(x-w/2),Math.round(y-h+bob),w,Math.max(1,h));}
      else{fill(g,'#342043',x-20,y-h,40,h);fill(g,'#eee1d4',x-7,y-h,14,21*manifest);}

      g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x,y+4,34+sigil*8,11+sigil*2,0,0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();
      g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x,y+4,20+sigil*5,6+sigil*1.3,0,0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();
      for(let k=0;k<6;k++){

        g.fillStyle=k%2?'#f5e3ff':'#a978ec';g.fillRect(Math.round(x+rx)-1,Math.round(y+4+ry)-1,3,3);

    g.fillStyle='#31211965';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x,y-3,26,9,0,0,7);g.fill();
    g.save();g.translate(x,y-42);g.rotate(Math.sin(t*.7+o.x*.002)*.018);g.translate(-x,-(y-42));
    drawAngelSprite(o,o.id==='vaniel'?108:96,b);g.restore();
    drawAngelActivity(o);
    const hues={vaniel:'rgba(255,129,168,.72)',akiriel:'rgba(245,204,132,.67)',meriel:'rgba(151,104,223,.65)',samuel:'rgba(245,234,192,.85)'};
    halo(o.x,o.y-39,38,hues[o.id],.15);

    g.strokeStyle='#fff0c1';g.lineWidth=3;g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y-24,32,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();
    fill(g,'#664b2f',x-29,y-38,58,45);
    g.fillStyle='#fff1c9';g.font='bold 24px Georgia';g.textAlign='center';g.fillText('1',x,y-5);g.textAlign='left';
    halo(o.x,o.y-25,82,'rgba(255,228,156,.56)',.18);return;
  }
  if(o.kind==='memory-portal'){
    fill(g,'#121018',x-47,y-42,94,63);fill(g,'#d0c2b6',x-50,y-47,100,10);
    g.strokeStyle='#eee0d5';g.lineWidth=3;g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y-24,32,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();
    fill(g,'#3b3035',x-29,y-38,58,45);
    g.fillStyle='#f1d9ce';g.font='bold 24px Georgia';g.textAlign='center';g.fillText('2',x,y-5);g.textAlign='left';
    halo(o.x,o.y-25,82,'rgba(219,216,218,.6)',.16);return;
  }
  if(o.kind==='clue'){
    if(o.id==='ceu'){drawWorldPulpit(x,y,skyBookRead);return;}
    const found=!!clues[o.id];
    fill(g,'#130f13',x-23,y-12,46,24);fill(g,'#776054',x-24,y-23,48,14);fill(g,'#a38a71',x-21,y-23,42,4);

    else if(o.id==='arquivo'){fill(g,'#c2c7bb',x-14,y-33,28,14);for(let i=0;i<3;i++)fill(g,'#667672',x-10,y-29+i*4,19,2);}
    else{fill(g,'#8d7056',x-15,y-27,30,7);fill(g,'#d1b17a',x-4,y-37,8,8);}
