const SCENE2_CAST={
  // Falas trabalham exclusivamente com os quatro papéis já estabelecidos. Sem novos acontecimentos ou revelações.
  andreas:{name:'Andreas',role:'vitima',start:{x:688,y:851},lines:[
    '“Conheça o Fogo do meu Ódio”'
  ]},
  johana:{name:'Johana',role:'motivacao',start:{x:264,y:858},lines:[
    '“O mundo já estava uma merda antes de mim. Só achei que precisava de uma trilha sonora.”'
  ]},
  niklaus:{name:'Niklaus',role:'manipulador',start:{x:425,y:1078},lines:[
    '“Se der merda, a gente finge que foi de propósito.”'
  ]},
  omega:{name:'Ômega',role:'carrasco',start:{x:535,y:1204},lines:[
    '“Toda história termina em algum momento. Nem sempre pelas mesmas mãos.”',
    '“É fácil enxergar o fim. Mais difícil é entender o que levou até ele.”'
  ]}
};
const SCENE2_DISPLAY_NAME='???';
const SCENE2_OBSERVE_TEXT={
  andreas:'A figura tem porte pesado, traços marcados e uma presença firme, como se suportasse um grande peso sem recuar. Mesmo imóvel, aparenta resistência, cansaço e uma força acostumada ao confronto.',
  johana:'A presença de cabelo vibrante e roupa marcante chama atenção imediatamente. A postura solta e a expressão insinuam irreverência, energia e uma autoconfiança difícil de conter.',
  niklaus:'O vulto de capuz e feições mais fechadas parece esconder parte de si no próprio silêncio. O jeito contido e o semblante discreto passam a impressão de alguém reservado, observador e difícil de ler.',
  omega:'A figura de cabelo curto e roupa escura mantém uma postura firme, quase agressiva. O semblante duro e a presença direta fazem parecer alguém decidido, intenso e pronto para agir.'
};
function scene2DisplayName(_id){return SCENE2_DISPLAY_NAME;}
let scene2Active=false,scene2Initialized=false,scene2Return=null,scene2Cast=[],scene2FollowId=null,scene2MenuId=null,scene2Solved=false;
function scene2Reset(){scene2Initialized=false;scene2Cast=[];scene2FollowId=null;scene2MenuId=null;scene2Solved=false;}
function scene2Prepare(){
  if(scene2Initialized)return;
  scene2Cast=Object.entries(SCENE2_CAST).map(([id,c])=>({id,name:c.name,x:c.start.x,y:c.start.y,homeX:c.start.x,homeY:c.start.y,slot:null,phase:Math.random()*6,dir:'down'}));
  scene2Initialized=true;
}
function enterScene2(){
  if(scene1Active)exitScene1(true);
  scene3SetMusicLevel(false);
  scene3Active=false;scene3MenuId=null;
  scene2Prepare();
  if(!scene2Active){scene2Return={...player};}
  scene2Active=true;scene2FollowId=null;
  toastExpire=0;$('toast').classList.add('hidden');
  scene2PianoLast=-100; scene2SetMusicLevel(true);
  player={...player,x:474,y:1450,vx:0,vy:0,dir:'up',moving:false,sprinting:false};
  camera.x=0;camera.y=clamp(player.y-H/2,0,SCENE2_H-H);
  setState('play');updateHUD();
  showDialogue('P',[
    'Nossa... esse salão é enorme! Mas está todo quebrado... Por que tem essas manchas vermelhas no chão?',
    'Tem gente aqui! Oi? Vocês conseguem me ouvir? ...Por que ninguém responde?',
    'Esses círculos no chão... Será que eles têm que ficar ali? Talvez eu possa ajudar...'
  ],'p',()=>toast('E: observar ou conduzir  ·  Q: soltar  ·  E nas marcas: posicionar',4.4));
}
function exitScene2(){
  scene2Active=false;scene2FollowId=null;scene2MenuId=null; scene2SetMusicLevel(false);
  if(scene2Return)player={...scene2Return,vx:0,vy:0,moving:false};
  else player={...center(18,11),dir:'right',vx:0,vy:0,moving:false};
  scene2Return=null;
  camera.x=clamp(player.x-W/2,0,MW*TILE-W);camera.y=clamp(player.y-H/2,0,MH*TILE-H);
  setState('play');updateHUD();toast('Você voltou ao Limiante.',2.2);
}
// Architectural collision of the established sanctuary. One contiguous, walkable shape
// follows the altar -> side galleries -> stairs -> long central bridge shown in the map.
// The values are environment coordinates (not screen coordinates) so camera motion cannot
// change the collision geometry. Keep the four existing sigils reachable.
const SCENE2_FLOOR_PROFILE=[
  [430,365,575], [530,345,605], [615,318,638], [694,296,665],
  [719,185,769], [843,170,781], [900,181,769], [952,305,653],
  [995,354,609], [1045,377,586], [1470,378,568], [1526,390,559]
];
function scene2FloorBounds(y){
  if(y<SCENE2_FLOOR_PROFILE[0][0]||y>SCENE2_FLOOR_PROFILE[SCENE2_FLOOR_PROFILE.length-1][0])return null;
  for(let i=1;i<SCENE2_FLOOR_PROFILE.length;i++){
    const [yb,lb,rb]=SCENE2_FLOOR_PROFILE[i];
    const [ya,la,ra]=SCENE2_FLOOR_PROFILE[i-1];
    if(y<=yb){const u=(y-ya)/(yb-ya);return [la+(lb-la)*u,ra+(rb-ra)*u];}
  }
  return null;
}
const SCENE2_SOLID_OBJECTS=[
  // Broken stone ribs at both edges of the landing; the center remains traversable.
  {x0:276,y0:899,x1:324,y1:1000},
  {x0:630,y0:901,x1:679,y1:1000},
  // The central shattered stone/crystal. Can be passed to either side.
  {x0:449,y0:631,x1:501,y1:704}
];
function scene2Allowed(x,y){
  const bounds=scene2FloorBounds(y);
  if(!bounds||x<bounds[0]||x>bounds[1])return false;
  for(const o of SCENE2_SOLID_OBJECTS)if(x>=o.x0&&x<=o.x1&&y>=o.y0&&y<=o.y1)return false;
  return true;
}
function scene2Can(x,y,withActors=true){
  const r=10;
  // Use the same collision rule at all four edges and at the center of P's feet.
  if(!scene2Allowed(x,y)||!scene2Allowed(x-r,y-r)||!scene2Allowed(x+r,y-r)||
     !scene2Allowed(x-r,y+r)||!scene2Allowed(x+r,y+r))return false;
  if(withActors){
    // The figures are memories but their silhouettes still occupy the floor; never allow
    // P to pass straight through a stationary token. A following echo is not an obstacle.
    for(const c of scene2Cast){
      if(c.id===scene2FollowId)continue;
      if(Math.hypot(c.x-x,(c.y-5)-y)<25)return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}
function scene2Actor(id){return scene2Cast.find(c=>c.id===id);}
function scene2SlotActor(id){return scene2Cast.find(c=>c.slot===id);}
function scene2Nearest(){
  if(scene2FollowId){const mk=SCENE2_MARKS.map(m=>({...m,kind:'scene2-mark',dist:dist(m,player)})).sort((a,b)=>a.dist-b.dist)[0];
    if(mk?.dist<85)return {...mk,name:'Fixar a presença · '+mk.name};
  }
  const near=scene2Cast.filter(a=>a.id!==scene2FollowId&&dist(a,player)<75).sort((a,b)=>dist(a,player)-dist(b,player))[0];
  if(near)return {kind:'scene2-actor',id:near.id,x:near.x,y:near.y,name:scene2DisplayName(near.id)+' · observar / conduzir'};
  if(scene2FollowId){const mine=scene2Actor(scene2FollowId);if(mine&&dist(mine,player)<85)return {kind:'scene2-drop',name:'Soltar '+scene2DisplayName(mine.id)};}
  const mk=SCENE2_MARKS.map(m=>({...m,kind:'scene2-mark',dist:dist(m,player)})).sort((a,b)=>a.dist-b.dist)[0];
  if(mk?.dist<66)return {...mk,name:mk.name+' · examinar'};
  if(player.y>1410&&Math.abs(player.x-474)<85)return {kind:'scene2-exit',name:'Retornar ao Limiante'};
  return null;
}
function scene2HUD(){
  $('location').textContent='Porta 2 · A Cena Incompleta';
  $('clue-count').textContent=Object.keys(clues).length;
  promptTarget=scene2Nearest();
  $('prompt').classList.toggle('hidden',!promptTarget||state!=='play');
  if(promptTarget)$('prompt').textContent='[ E ] '+promptTarget.name;
  $('status').textContent=scene2Solved?'A VERDADE VOLTOU AO MÁRMORE':'UMA MEMÓRIA FORA DE ORDEM';
}
function scene2OpenActor(id){
  scene2MenuId=id;
  $('scene2-action-title').textContent=scene2DisplayName(id);
  $('scene2-listen').textContent='1 · OBSERVAR PRESENÇA';
  $('scene2-lead').textContent=scene2Actor(id)?.slot?'2 · REPOSICIONAR FIGURA':'2 · CONDUZIR A FIGURA';
  setState('scene2-actions');
}
function scene2Choose(which){
  if(!scene2MenuId){setState('play');return;}
  const id=scene2MenuId;scene2MenuId=null;
  setState('play');
  if(which==='listen'){
    showDialogue(scene2DisplayName(id),[SCENE2_OBSERVE_TEXT[id]||'A presença permanece imóvel diante de você.'],id);
    return;
  }
  if(which==='lead'){
    const prev=scene2FollowId;if(prev&&prev!==id){const old=scene2Actor(prev),p=scene2NearbyFree(player.x,player.y,prev);old.x=p.x;old.y=p.y;}
    scene2FollowId=id;
    const c=scene2Actor(id);c.slot=null;
    toast('A presença tornou-se um eco à sua frente. Leve-a até uma marca e pressione E.',3.2);
  }
}
function scene2NearbyFree(x,y,exceptId=null){
  // Search a small ring on the nearest valid floor; never push characters inside walls.
  for(const radius of [58,76,92,114,136])for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
    const a=i*Math.PI/8,xx=x+Math.cos(a)*radius,yy=y+Math.sin(a)*radius;
    if(!scene2Can(xx,yy,false))continue;
    if(scene2Cast.some(c=>c.id!==exceptId&&Math.hypot(c.x-xx,c.y-yy)<40))continue;
    return {x:xx,y:yy};
  }
  // Safe fallback: remain at the mark until P interacts again.
  return {x,y};
}
function scene2Drop(){if(!scene2FollowId)return;const c=scene2Actor(scene2FollowId);const p=scene2NearbyFree(player.x,player.y,c.id);c.x=p.x;c.y=p.y;scene2FollowId=null;toast('A figura voltou a permanecer imóvel.',1.8);}
function scene2Place(markId){
  if(!scene2FollowId)return;
  const target=SCENE2_MARKS.find(s=>s.id===markId);if(!target)return;
  const current=scene2SlotActor(markId);
  if(current&&current.id!==scene2FollowId){
    current.slot=null;
    const free=scene2NearbyFree(target.x,target.y,current.id);
    current.x=free.x;current.y=free.y;
  }
  for(const other of scene2Cast){
    if(other.id!==scene2FollowId&&!other.slot&&Math.hypot(other.x-target.x,other.y-target.y)<62){
      const free=scene2NearbyFree(target.x,target.y,other.id);
      other.x=free.x;other.y=free.y;
    }
  }
  const c=scene2Actor(scene2FollowId);c.slot=markId;c.x=target.x;c.y=target.y;
  scene2FollowId=null;playSound('key');
  toast(c.name+' foi fixado nesta lembrança.',2);
  scene2Check();
}
function scene2Check(){
  if(scene2Solved)return;
  if(scene2Cast.every(c=>c.slot&&SCENE2_CAST[c.id].role===c.slot)){
    scene2Solved=true;clues.relicario='1';playSound('clue');playSound('success');updateHUD();
    showDialogue('A MEMÓRIA RECONSTRUÍDA',[
      'As quatro figuras ocupam os lugares que pertencem a esta lembrança. A cena está completa.',
      'Uma única marca surge no centro do altar: **1**. Você recuperou a segunda cifra da Grande Porta.'
    ],'p');
  }else if(scene2Cast.every(c=>c.slot)){
    playSound('fail');toast('As quatro marcas foram ocupadas. A lembrança ainda não faz sentido.',3.7);
  }
}
function scene2Interact(){
  const o=scene2Nearest();if(!o){if(scene2FollowId)toast('Conduza o eco até uma das quatro marcas. Q para soltá-lo.',2);else toast('Nada responde à sua presença.',0.6);return;}
  if(o.kind==='scene2-exit'){exitScene2();return;}
  if(o.kind==='scene2-actor'){scene2OpenActor(o.id);return;}
  if(o.kind==='scene2-drop'){scene2Drop();return;}
  if(o.kind==='scene2-mark'){
    if(scene2FollowId){scene2Place(o.id);return;}
    const c=scene2SlotActor(o.id);if(c){scene2OpenActor(c.id);return;}
    showDialogue('GRAVAÇÃO NO MÁRMORE',[o.hint],'p');return;
  }
}
function scene2Click(e){
  const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),mx=(e.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width*W+camera.x-6,my=(e.clientY-rect.top)/rect.height*H+camera.y;
  // Hit-test the FULL visible sprite, including the taller head and wider clothing.
  // The character's map coordinates stay anchored at its feet.
  const selectable=scene2Cast.filter(c=>c.id!==scene2FollowId && dist(c,player)<155)
    .filter(c=>mx>=c.x-SCENE2_TOKEN_WIDTH/2-7 && mx<=c.x+SCENE2_TOKEN_WIDTH/2+7
        && my>=c.y-SCENE2_TOKEN_HEIGHT-7 && my<=c.y+8)
    .sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-mx,a.y-SCENE2_TOKEN_HEIGHT/2-my)-Math.hypot(b.x-mx,b.y-SCENE2_TOKEN_HEIGHT/2-my));
  if(selectable.length){scene2OpenActor(selectable[0].id);return;}
  if(scene2FollowId){const mk=SCENE2_MARKS.find(m=>Math.hypot(m.x-mx,m.y-my)<70&&dist(m,player)<140);if(mk){scene2Place(mk.id);return;}}
}
function scene2Update(dt){
  if(state==='play'){
    let dx=(heldKeys.has('d')||heldKeys.has('arrowright')?1:0)-(heldKeys.has('a')||heldKeys.has('arrowleft')?1:0);
    let dy=(heldKeys.has('s')||heldKeys.has('arrowdown')?1:0)-(heldKeys.has('w')||heldKeys.has('arrowup')?1:0);
    let len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(len){dx/=len;dy/=len;if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy))player.dir=dx>0?'right':'left';else player.dir=dy>0?'down':'up';}
    player.sprinting=!!len&&heldKeys.has('shift');
    const goal=player.sprinting?230:165,blend=1-Math.exp(-dt*(len?13.8:20));
    player.vx=(player.vx||0)+(dx*goal-(player.vx||0))*blend;
    player.vy=(player.vy||0)+(dy*goal-(player.vy||0))*blend;
    if(Math.abs(player.vx)<.1)player.vx=0;if(Math.abs(player.vy)<.1)player.vy=0;
    const ox=player.x,oy=player.y;
    if(scene2Can(player.x+player.vx*dt,player.y))player.x+=player.vx*dt;else player.vx=0;
    if(scene2Can(player.x,player.y+player.vy*dt))player.y+=player.vy*dt;else player.vy=0;
    const traveled=Math.hypot(player.x-ox,player.y-oy);player.moving=traveled>.08;player.step+=traveled/19;
    player.moveBlend+=(Number(player.moving)-player.moveBlend)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*12));
    player.lean+=(clamp(player.vx/205,-1,1)*.038-player.lean)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*9));
    if(scene2FollowId){
      const c=scene2Actor(scene2FollowId),desiredX=player.x-(dx||0)*45+(dx===0?37:0),desiredY=player.y-(dy||0)*48+48;
      if(c){const a=1-Math.exp(-dt*9),nx=c.x+(desiredX-c.x)*a,ny=c.y+(desiredY-c.y)*a;
        if(scene2Can(nx,c.y,false))c.x=nx;
        if(scene2Can(c.x,ny,false))c.y=ny;
      }
    }
    updateHUD();
  }
  const targetY=clamp(player.y-H/2,0,SCENE2_H-H);
  camera.y+=(targetY-camera.y)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*9));camera.x=0;
}
function scene2Ring(m){
  const x=tx(m.x)+6,y=ty(m.y),t=gameTime*.9;
  const occupied=!!scene2SlotActor(m.id);
  const mark=assets.scene2_mark_red;
  g.save();g.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  if(mark?.naturalWidth){
    // Visible crimson gothic marker on the FLOOR, centered on the original interactive slot.
    // It does not replace or move the collision/interact coordinates.
    g.globalAlpha=(occupied?.98:.88)+Math.sin(t*1.8+m.x*.01)*.04;
    g.shadowColor='rgba(222,31,68,.78)';
    g.shadowBlur=occupied?9:14;
    g.drawImage(mark,Math.round(x-60),Math.round(y-30),120,60);
  }else{
    // Fallback when a graphics driver or external file fails to load.
    g.globalAlpha=.9;g.strokeStyle='#e23b56';g.lineWidth=4;
    g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x,y,49,22,0,0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();
  }
  g.globalAlpha=1;g.shadowBlur=0;
  g.textAlign='center';g.font='bold 17px Georgia';g.lineWidth=4;
  g.strokeStyle='#310b19';g.strokeText(m.roman,x,y+5);
  g.fillStyle=occupied?'#ffe2ae':'#fff4e3';g.fillText(m.roman,x,y+5);
  g.textAlign='left';g.restore();
}
function drawSubtleTimeAnomaly(kind){
  // Purely visual, original memory-related treatment. No clues, events, or plot changes.
  const period=kind==='gold'?16.3:19.4;
  const phase=(gameTime+(kind==='gold'?1.9:5.6))%period;
  if(phase>.48)return;
  const intensity=Math.sin(Math.PI*phase/.48)*.55;
  if(intensity<=0)return;
  g.save();
  g.globalAlpha=.035*intensity;
  g.fillStyle=kind==='gold'?'#ffecaa':'#d7d3e9';g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // Two tiny scanline discontinuities suggest that the moment has already happened.
  g.globalAlpha=.09*intensity;
  g.fillStyle=kind==='gold'?'#fff1c7':'#a69db1';
  const off=kind==='gold'?4:17;
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const y=Math.floor(((i*169+off*31+H/3)%H)/4)*4;
    g.fillRect(0,y,W,1);
  }
  g.restore();
}
function renderScene2(){
  g.clearRect(0,0,W,H);g.fillStyle='#110d10';g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);g.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  const mapImage=assets.scene2_sanctuary_pixel;
  const mapX=6, mapY=-Math.floor(camera.y), mapW=SCENE2_W, mapH=SCENE2_H;
  if(mapImage?.naturalWidth)g.drawImage(mapImage,mapX,mapY,mapW,mapH);
  // Cover residual black voids with warm stone extensions so the chapel feels structurally continuous.
  g.save();
  fill(g,'#7d654f',0,0,34,H); fill(g,'#7d654f',926,0,34,H);
  fill(g,'#5f4a39',0,0,18,H); fill(g,'#5f4a39',942,0,18,H);
  fill(g,'#9a7c61',18,0,10,H); fill(g,'#9a7c61',932,0,10,H);
  fill(g,'#826850',0,0,W,24); fill(g,'#5e4a39',0,0,W,10);
  // Upper shoulders of the sanctuary to visually connect the round apse walls.
  g.beginPath();g.fillStyle='rgba(146,117,90,.95)';g.moveTo(0,0);g.lineTo(106,0);g.lineTo(68,82);g.lineTo(0,112);g.closePath();g.fill();
  g.beginPath();g.fillStyle='rgba(146,117,90,.95)';g.moveTo(W,0);g.lineTo(W-106,0);g.lineTo(W-68,82);g.lineTo(W,112);g.closePath();g.fill();
  g.beginPath();g.fillStyle='rgba(92,71,54,.82)';g.moveTo(0,28);g.lineTo(72,28);g.lineTo(48,104);g.lineTo(0,124);g.closePath();g.fill();
  g.beginPath();g.fillStyle='rgba(92,71,54,.82)';g.moveTo(W,28);g.lineTo(W-72,28);g.lineTo(W-48,104);g.lineTo(W,124);g.closePath();g.fill();
  g.restore();
  for(const m of SCENE2_MARKS)scene2Ring(m);
  // An unmoving, suffocating place; the masonry has no independent life.
  const drawOrder=[...scene2Cast.map(c=>({kind:'echo',o:c,y:c.y})),{kind:'p',y:player.y}].sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y);
  for(const item of drawOrder){
    if(item.kind==='echo'){
      const c=item.o,x=tx(c.x)+6,y=ty(c.y),im=assets['scene2_'+c.id];
      if(y< -150||y>H+120)continue;
      g.fillStyle='#08090ba6';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x,y-1,23,7,0,0,7);g.fill();
      if(c.id===scene2FollowId)halo(c.x+6,c.y-SCENE2_TOKEN_HEIGHT*.40,69,'rgba(231,200,149,.8)',.2);
      if(im?.naturalWidth){const bob=Math.sin(gameTime*1.35+c.phase)*1.2;g.save();g.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';g.globalAlpha=.92;g.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;g.drawImage(im,Math.round(x-SCENE2_TOKEN_WIDTH/2),Math.round(y-SCENE2_TOKEN_HEIGHT+bob),SCENE2_TOKEN_WIDTH,SCENE2_TOKEN_HEIGHT);g.restore();g.globalAlpha=1;}
      if(c.slot)halo(c.x+6,c.y-18,38,'rgba(255,224,159,.6)',.11);
      // Nomes permanecem apenas nas caixas de interação, nunca acima dos tokens.
    }else{
      const x=tx(player.x)+6,y=ty(player.y);
      g.fillStyle='#080609b0';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x,y+2,17,5,0,0,7);g.fill();
      g.save();g.translate(6,0);drawAnimatedP(player.x,player.y,P_RENDER_SIZE,player.dir,player.moving?Math.sin(gameTime*(player.sprinting?15:11))*2:0);g.restore();
    }
  }
  if(scene2Solved){
    const m=SCENE2_MARKS[0],x=m.x+6,y=m.y-camera.y-112;
    halo(m.x+6,m.y-112,85,'rgba(251,218,158,.8)',.65);
    g.save();g.font='bold 52px Georgia';g.textAlign='center';g.shadowBlur=18;g.shadowColor='#f7e3b0';g.fillStyle='#fff0bf';g.fillText('1',x,y);g.restore();
  }
  // The way out remains at the southern limit of the long corridor.
  const ex=480,ey=1510-camera.y;
  g.save();g.globalAlpha=.5+.16*Math.sin(gameTime*1.8);g.fillStyle='#d5bc9c';g.font='bold 15px Georgia';g.textAlign='center';g.fillText('↧ VOLTAR A LIMIANTE',ex,ey);g.restore();
  drawSubtleTimeAnomaly('stone');
  // Muted vignette: only along the borders, never over the objective markers.
  let shade=g.createRadialGradient(W/2,H/2,160,W/2,H/2,590);shade.addColorStop(0,'rgba(7,6,11,0)');shade.addColorStop(1,'rgba(7,6,11,.43)');g.fillStyle=shade;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  g.save();g.globalAlpha=.88;g.fillStyle='#0c0b10b6';g.fillRect(355,8,255,46);g.strokeStyle='#7a6064';g.strokeRect(355,8,255,46);g.font='10px Courier New';g.fillStyle='#e8cfd0';g.fillText('MEMÓRIA 02 · CENA INCOMPLETA',368,26);g.fillStyle='#b89c9d';g.fillText('MARCAS RECONSTRUÍDAS  '+scene2Cast.filter(a=>a.slot).length+'/4',368,42);g.restore();
}

// Música ORIGINAL de Limiante. Síntese WebAudio, sem arquivos de áudio externos:
// um tema de acolhimento durante o despertar e um tema sombrio para exploração.
// Os dois têm canais próprios para a transição suave; Céu Dourado e Memória 02 permanecem intactos.
let limCalmBus=null,limTenseBus=null,limTenseDrone=null;
let limCalmLast=-100,limTenseLast=-100,limCalmPhrase=0,limTensePhrase=0;
let limFadeStart=null;
function limEnsureMusic(){
  if(!audioCtx)return;
  if(limCalmBus)return;
  limCalmBus=audioCtx.createGain();limCalmBus.gain.value=0;limCalmBus.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  limTenseBus=audioCtx.createGain();limTenseBus.gain.value=0;limTenseBus.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  // A cama grave é quase imperceptível sozinha, mas cria profundidade sob a melodia.
  const filter=audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=265;
  const mixed=audioCtx.createGain();mixed.gain.value=.26;
  filter.connect(mixed);mixed.connect(limTenseBus);
  for(const [hz,level,type] of [[54.9,.046,'sine'],[56.2,.026,'triangle'],[82.4,.013,'sine']]){
    const osc=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.type=type;osc.frequency.value=hz;g.gain.value=level;
    osc.connect(g);g.connect(filter);osc.start();
  }
}
function limTone(hz,when,dur,peak,bus,type='sine'){
  if(!audioCtx||!bus)return;
  const osc=audioCtx.createOscillator(),env=audioCtx.createGain(),f=audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  osc.type=type;osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(hz,when);
  f.type='lowpass';f.frequency.value=type==='triangle'?1150:1950;f.Q.value=.6;
  env.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,when);
  env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(.0002,peak),when+.048);
  env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,when+dur);
  osc.connect(f);f.connect(env);env.connect(bus);osc.start(when);osc.stop(when+dur+.015);
}
function limPlayCalm(){
  if(!audioCtx||!limCalmBus)return;
  const t=audioCtx.currentTime+.07;
  // Frases originais lentas e infantis: pequenos intervalos luminosos, sem bateria.
  const melody=[
    [[261.63,0,.031],[329.63,.84,.023],[392,1.76,.024],[329.63,2.62,.018],[293.66,4.03,.021]],
    [[293.66,0,.028],[349.23,.88,.024],[440,1.70,.024],[392,2.74,.018],[329.63,4.08,.019]],
    [[261.63,0,.029],[349.23,.92,.022],[392,1.93,.023],[523.25,2.71,.019],[392,4.17,.018]],
    [[246.94,0,.026],[293.66,.93,.021],[349.23,1.83,.021],[329.63,3.01,.019],[261.63,4.11,.020]]
  ];
  const line=melody[(limCalmPhrase++)%melody.length];
  for(const [hz,d,vol] of line){
    limTone(hz,t+d,2.25,vol,limCalmBus,'sine');
    limTone(hz*2,t+d+.012,1.13,vol*.14,limCalmBus,'triangle');
  }
  limTone(line[0][0]/2,t,5.13,.014,limCalmBus,'sine');
}
function limPlayTension(){
  if(!audioCtx||!limTenseBus)return;
  const t=audioCtx.currentTime+.09;
  // Pulsos metálicos, dissonâncias sutis e silêncios: jamais um som de perseguição.
  const patterns=[
    [[110,0,.018],[116.54,1.74,.012],[146.83,3.58,.014]],
    [[98,0,.015],[123.47,1.46,.012],[103.83,3.76,.014]],
    [[103.83,0,.017],[110,1.88,.013],[155.56,3.47,.012]],
    [[92.50,0,.016],[116.54,1.51,.011],[138.59,3.73,.012]]
  ];
  const line=patterns[(limTensePhrase++)%patterns.length];
  for(const [hz,d,vol] of line){
    limTone(hz,t+d,2.55,vol,limTenseBus,'triangle');
    limTone(hz*2.009,t+d+.12,1.42,vol*.29,limTenseBus,'sine');
  }
  // Baque subgrave ocasional e contido; o ruído dos Priantes continua audível.
  limTone(58.27,t+4.65,.75,.013,limTenseBus,'sine');
}
function limSyncMusic(){
  if(!audioCtx)return;
  limEnsureMusic();
  const sky=roomAt(player.x,player.y)?.id==='ceu';
  const allowed=audioOn&&!scene1Active&&!scene2Active&&!scene3Active&&!sky&&!['start','pause','death','win','glitch'].includes(state);
  const mix=limFadeStart===null?0:clamp((gameTime-limFadeStart)/8,0,1);
  const now=audioCtx.currentTime;
  const fadeOut=!audioOn?.07:!allowed?.28:null;
  limCalmBus.gain.setTargetAtTime(allowed?(1-mix):0,now,fadeOut??.65);
  limTenseBus.gain.setTargetAtTime(allowed?mix:0,now,fadeOut??1.04);
  if(!allowed)return;
  if(mix<.99&&gameTime-limCalmLast>5.6){limCalmLast=gameTime;limPlayCalm();}
  if(mix>.01&&gameTime-limTenseLast>5.6){limTenseLast=gameTime;limPlayTension();}
}

function soundSetup(){if(audioCtx)return;try{audioCtx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();let gain=audioCtx.createGain();ambientGain=gain;gain.gain.value=.014;gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);for(const [frequency,type] of [[55,'sine'],[56.1,'triangle']]){let o=audioCtx.createOscillator();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=frequency;o.connect(gain);o.start();oscillators.push(o);}}catch(e){audioOn=false;}}
function playSound(kind){if(!audioOn)return;soundSetup();if(!audioCtx)return;if(audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume().catch(()=>{});
  let t=audioCtx.currentTime,osc=audioCtx.createOscillator(),a=audioCtx.createGain();
  const cfg={text:[270,210,.07,.022],step:[60,40,.07,.013],clue:[390,800,.47,.065],key:[500,440,.08,.04],fail:[145,62,.34,.075],success:[330,750,.54,.075],death:[110,35,1.2,.14],'gate-open':[90,41,.83,.082]}[kind]||[190,160,.1,.03];
  osc.type=['clue','success'].includes(kind)?'sine':'triangle';osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(cfg[0],t);osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(cfg[1],t+cfg[2]);a.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);a.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(cfg[3],t+.014);a.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+cfg[2]);osc.connect(a);a.connect(audioCtx.destination);osc.start(t);osc.stop(t+cfg[2]+.01);
}
function playGateMechanism(){
  if(!audioOn)return;soundSetup();if(!audioCtx)return;
  const now=audioCtx.currentTime;
  const master=audioCtx.createGain();master.gain.value=.025;
  const lowpass=audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();lowpass.type='lowpass';lowpass.frequency.value=340;
  lowpass.connect(master);master.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const osc=audioCtx.createOscillator(),gain=audioCtx.createGain();
    osc.type=i?'triangle':'sawtooth';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(i?66:49,now);
    osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(i?48:37,now+1.8);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now);
    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.38,now+.19);
    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+2.6);
    osc.connect(gain);gain.connect(lowpass);osc.start(now);osc.stop(now+2.65);
  }
}
function playPrianteChitter(distanceToP,pan=0){
  // Original, synthesized Priante voice: dry mandible clicks over a guttural,
  // broken, insect-like cry. No external audio, no borrowed game recordings.
  if(!audioOn||!audioCtx||audioCtx.state!=='running')return;
  const ctx=audioCtx,now=ctx.currentTime;
  const proximity=clamp(1-distanceToP/690,0,1);
  if(proximity<=0)return;
  const duration=.40+random()*.19,master=ctx.createGain();
  master.gain.value=.035+.090*proximity;
  const panner=ctx.createStereoPanner?.();
  if(panner){panner.pan.value=clamp(pan,-.82,.82);master.connect(panner);panner.connect(ctx.destination);}
  else master.connect(ctx.destination);
  // Filtered rasp: makes the cry distinguishable from footsteps.
  const noise=ctx.createBuffer(1,Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*duration),ctx.sampleRate),raw=noise.getChannelData(0);
  let sm=0;for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++){sm=.58*sm+.42*(random()*2-1);raw[i]=sm;}
  const hiss=ctx.createBufferSource(),hissF=ctx.createBiquadFilter(),hissEnv=ctx.createGain();
  hiss.buffer=noise;hissF.type='bandpass';hissF.frequency.value=690+random()*520;hissF.Q.value=1.15;
  hissEnv.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now);
  hissEnv.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.10,now+.07);
  hissEnv.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.06,now+duration*.6);
  hissEnv.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+duration);
  hiss.connect(hissF);hissF.connect(hissEnv);hissEnv.connect(master);
  hiss.start(now);hiss.stop(now+duration);
  // Two detuned throat harmonics sweep down, with a deliberately irregular call.
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const voice=ctx.createOscillator(),filter=ctx.createBiquadFilter(),env=ctx.createGain();
    voice.type=i===0?'sawtooth':'triangle';
    voice.frequency.setValueAtTime((i===0?155:104)+random()*25,now);
    voice.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime((i===0?47:36)+random()*15,now+duration);
    filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=i===0?560:360;
    env.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now);
    env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(i===0?.25:.13,now+.065+i*.021);
    env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+duration);
    voice.connect(filter);filter.connect(env);env.connect(master);
    voice.start(now);voice.stop(now+duration+.02);
  }
  // Sharp mandible clicks at uneven intervals, recognizable at medium distance.
  const n=3+Math.floor(random()*3);
  for(let j=0;j<n;j++){
    const t=now+.035+j*(.062+random()*.03);
    const click=ctx.createOscillator(),env=ctx.createGain();
    click.type='square';click.frequency.setValueAtTime(860+random()*850,t);
    click.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(240+random()*220,t+.027);
    env.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.045,t+.003);
    env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.040);
    click.connect(env);env.connect(master);click.start(t);click.stop(t+.045);
  }
}
function pluckHarp(hz,when,gain=.036){
  if(!audioCtx)return;
  let osc=audioCtx.createOscillator(),en=audioCtx.createGain(),filter=audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
  osc.type='triangle';osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(hz,when);
  filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=2250;
  en.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,when);en.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain,when+.018);
  en.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,when+2.25);
  osc.connect(filter);filter.connect(en);en.connect(ensureSkyHarpBus()||audioCtx.destination);osc.start(when);osc.stop(when+2.28);
  // Whisper-like second harmonic; all notes original and procedural.
  let tw=audioCtx.createOscillator(),gain2=audioCtx.createGain();tw.type='sine';tw.frequency.value=hz*2;
  gain2.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,when);gain2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain*.18,when+.011);
  gain2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,when+1.15);tw.connect(gain2);gain2.connect(ensureSkyHarpBus()||audioCtx.destination);
  tw.start(when);tw.stop(when+1.18);
}
function playHarpPhrase(){
  if(!audioCtx)return;
  if(audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume().catch(()=>{});
  const chords=[[220,261.63,329.63,440],[196,246.94,293.66,392],[174.61,220,261.63,349.23],[196,246.94,329.63,392]];
  let a=chords[(harpIndex++)%chords.length],now=audioCtx.currentTime+.07;
  a.forEach((f,i)=>pluckHarp(f,now+i*.49,i===0?.028:.019));
  pluckHarp(a[2]*2,now+2.4,.012);
}
// Trilha ORIGINAL de piano de suspense da Memória 02: gerada em tempo real,
// sem arquivos externos e sem reproduzir música de terceiros.
function scene2SetMusicLevel(shouldPlay){
  if(!audioCtx)return;
  if(!scene2PianoBus){scene2PianoBus=audioCtx.createGain();scene2PianoBus.gain.value=0;scene2PianoBus.connect(audioCtx.destination);}
  scene2PianoBus.gain.setTargetAtTime((shouldPlay&&audioOn)?1:0,audioCtx.currentTime,.18);
}
function scene2MakePianoBuffer(){
  if(scene2PianoBuffer||!audioCtx)return;
  const len=Math.ceil(audioCtx.sampleRate*3.3), b=audioCtx.createBuffer(1,len,audioCtx.sampleRate), data=b.getChannelData(0);
  const sr=audioCtx.sampleRate;
  for(let i=0;i<len;i++){
    const s=i/sr, attack=1-Math.exp(-s*950), decay=Math.exp(-s*1.48);
    let value=0;
    const parts=[[1,1],[2,.36],[3,.17],[4,.085],[5,.035]];
    for(const [h,a] of parts)value+=a*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*220*h*s+(h-1)*.08)*Math.exp(-s*(h-1)*.82);
    data[i]=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,value*attack*decay*.63));
  }
  scene2PianoBuffer=b;
}
function scene2PianoNote(hz,when,vol=.048){
  if(!scene2PianoBus||!scene2PianoBuffer)return;
  const src=audioCtx.createBufferSource(),tone=audioCtx.createBiquadFilter(),gain=audioCtx.createGain();
  src.buffer=scene2PianoBuffer;src.playbackRate.value=hz/220;
  tone.type='lowpass';tone.frequency.value=1800;tone.Q.value=.65;
  gain.gain.value=vol;
  src.connect(tone);tone.connect(gain);gain.connect(scene2PianoBus);
  src.start(when);
  // Echo discreto, sempre atenuado e contido na mesma sala.
  const echo=audioCtx.createBufferSource(),eg=audioCtx.createGain();echo.buffer=scene2PianoBuffer;echo.playbackRate.value=hz/220;
  eg.gain.value=vol*.20;echo.connect(eg);eg.connect(scene2PianoBus);echo.start(when+.24);
}
function playScene2PianoPhrase(){
  if(!audioOn)return;soundSetup();if(!audioCtx)return;
  if(audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume().catch(()=>{});
  scene2MakePianoBuffer();scene2SetMusicLevel(true);
  const now=audioCtx.currentTime+.08;

    [[220,0,.045],[261.63,.82,.032],[311.13,1.95,.032],[164.81,3.35,.037]],
    [[196,0,.039],[233.08,1.06,.031],[220,2.34,.033],[155.56,3.66,.035]],
    [[174.61,0,.043],[207.65,1.1,.035],[293.66,2.4,.028],[146.83,3.8,.032]],
    [[220,0,.043],[155.56,1.22,.03],[261.63,2.51,.035],[164.81,3.70,.035]]
  ];
  for(const [hz,delay,vol] of patterns[(scene2PianoPhrase++)%patterns.length])scene2PianoNote(hz,now+delay,vol);
}
// Trilha ORIGINAL para a Biblioteca: piano sereno de exploração fantástica.
// Harmonias claras, arpejos calmos e uma melodia inédita, sem reutilizar temas de outros jogos.
function scene3SetMusicLevel(shouldPlay){
  if(!audioCtx)return;
  if(!scene3PianoBus){scene3PianoBus=audioCtx.createGain();scene3PianoBus.gain.value=0;scene3PianoBus.connect(audioCtx.destination);}
  scene3PianoBus.gain.setTargetAtTime((shouldPlay&&audioOn)?1:0,audioCtx.currentTime,.24);

function scene3PianoNote(midi,when,vol=.027){
  if(!scene3PianoBus||!scene2PianoBuffer||!audioCtx)return;
  const hz=440*Math.pow(2,(midi-69)/12);
  const src=audioCtx.createBufferSource(),filter=audioCtx.createBiquadFilter(),gain=audioCtx.createGain();
  src.buffer=scene2PianoBuffer;src.playbackRate.value=hz/220;
  filter.type='lowpass';filter.frequency.value=2850;filter.Q.value=.4;
  gain.gain.value=vol;
  src.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(scene3PianoBus);
  src.start(when);
  // Discreta reverberação de ambiente, com uma segunda nota atenuada.
  const echo=audioCtx.createBufferSource(),eg=audioCtx.createGain();
  echo.buffer=scene2PianoBuffer;echo.playbackRate.value=hz/220;
  eg.gain.value=vol*.13;echo.connect(eg);eg.connect(scene3PianoBus);echo.start(when+.29);

function playScene3PianoPhrase(){
  if(!audioOn)return;soundSetup();if(!audioCtx)return;
  if(audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume().catch(()=>{});
  scene2MakePianoBuffer();scene3SetMusicLevel(true);
  const now=audioCtx.currentTime+.075;
  // Oito frases próprias; tonalidade maior com variações de suspensões, sem motivos emprestados.
  const phrases=[
    {bass:[50,57,62,57],mel:[69,66,64,66,73,69,66]},    // D(add9)
    {bass:[49,57,61,57],mel:[73,71,69,66,64,66,69]},    // A/C#
    {bass:[47,54,59,54],mel:[66,69,71,69,66,64,62]},    // Bm7
    {bass:[43,50,55,50],mel:[62,66,69,71,69,66,64]},    // Gmaj9
    {bass:[40,47,52,47],mel:[64,66,67,71,69,67,66]},    // Em7
    {bass:[45,52,57,52],mel:[69,71,73,76,73,71,69]},    // Aadd9
    {bass:[42,49,54,49],mel:[66,69,73,71,69,66,64]},    // F#m7
    {bass:[43,50,55,52],mel:[62,66,69,66,64,61,62]}     // G(add9) -> D
  ];
  const phrase=phrases[(scene3PianoPhrase++)%phrases.length];
  const bassDelay=[0,1.55,3.1,4.65];
  for(let i=0;i<phrase.bass.length;i++)scene3PianoNote(phrase.bass[i],now+bassDelay[i],i===0?.046:.027);
  const melodyDelay=[.3,.93,1.72,2.68,3.52,4.43,5.39];
  for(let i=0;i<phrase.mel.length;i++)scene3PianoNote(phrase.mel[i],now+melodyDelay[i],i===0?.037:.029);
}
function toggleAudio(){audioOn=!audioOn;if(!audioOn&&samaelDreadBus&&audioCtx)samaelDreadBus.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,audioCtx.currentTime,.03);if(audioOn){soundSetup();lastHarp=-30;scene2PianoLast=-100;scene3PianoLast=-100;limCalmLast=-100;limTenseLast=-100;}scene2SetMusicLevel(scene2Active);scene3SetMusicLevel(scene3Active&&['play','dialog','scene3-actions'].includes(state));if(audioCtx&&ambientGain)ambientGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(audioOn?.008:0,audioCtx.currentTime,.15);limSyncMusic();$('audio-toggle').textContent=audioOn?'◉ ÁUDIO: LIGADO':'◌ ÁUDIO: DESLIGADO';playSound('key');}

function onKeyDown(e){let key=e.key.toLowerCase();if(state==='waking'){e.preventDefault();if((key==='e'||key==='enter'||key===' ')&&!e.repeat){wakeStartTime=gameTime-wakeDuration-.05;finishWaking();}return;}if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright',' ','enter'].includes(key))e.preventDefault();if(state==='play' && ['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright','w','a','s','d','shift'].includes(key))heldKeys.add(key);
  if(state==='scene3-actions'){e.preventDefault();if(['1','2','3','4','escape','enter'].includes(key))scene3Choose(key==='escape'?'4':key==='enter'?'1':key);return;}
  if(state==='scene2-actions'){e.preventDefault();if(key==='1'||key==='enter')scene2Choose('listen');else if(key==='2')scene2Choose('lead');else if(key==='3'||key==='escape')scene2Choose('cancel');return;}
  if(state==='keypad'){if(/^[0-9]$/.test(key))digit(key);else if(key==='backspace'){inputCode=inputCode.slice(0,-1);updateCode();}else if(key==='enter')checkCode();else if(key==='escape')setState('play');return;}
  if(state==='lumini-questions'){
    if(!e.repeat&&['1','2','3'].includes(key))askLumini(['place','why','name'][Number(key)-1]);
    else if(!e.repeat&&key==='escape')setState('play');
    return;
  }
  if(state==='painting'&&['enter','e','escape',' '].includes(key)){
    if(!e.repeat)setState('play');return;
  }
  if(state==='dialog'&&['enter','e',' '].includes(key)){if(!e.repeat)nextDialogue();return;}
  if(state==='play'){
    if(scene1Active&&key==='q'&&!e.repeat){exitScene1();return;}
    if(scene2Active&&key==='q'&&!e.repeat){scene2Drop();return;}if(key==='e'&&!e.repeat){interact();return;}if(key==='i'&&!e.repeat){inventory();return;}if(key==='m'&&!e.repeat){showMap();return;}if(key==='escape'){setState('pause');return;}
  }else if(state==='inventory'&&(key==='i'||key==='escape'))setState('play');
  else if(state==='map'&&(key==='m'||key==='escape'))setState('play');
  else if(state==='pause'&&key==='escape')setState('play');
}
function createKeys(){const e=$('keys');for(const d of ['1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9','·','0','⌫']){let b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=d;b.disabled=d==='·';b.onclick=()=>{if(d==='⌫'){inputCode=inputCode.slice(0,-1);updateCode();playSound('key');}else digit(d);};e.append(b);}}

  $('enter-key').onclick=checkCode;$('clear-key').onclick=()=>{inputCode='';updateCode();};$('cancel-key').onclick=()=>setState('play');
  $('inventory-close').onclick=()=>setState('play');$('inventory-toggle').onclick=inventory;$('map-close').onclick=()=>setState('play');$('painting-close').onclick=()=>setState('play');
  $('resume-btn').onclick=()=>setState('play');
  $('pause-toggle').onclick=()=>{if(state==='play')setState('pause');else if(state==='pause')setState('play');};
  $('pause-sky').onclick=()=>{scene1Active=false;scene1Return=null;scene3Active=false;scene2Active=false;scene2FollowId=null;scene2SetMusicLevel(false);scene3SetMusicLevel(false);player={...center(47,12),dir:'right',vx:0,vy:0,moving:false};enterScene1();};
  $('pause-gate').onclick=()=>{scene1Active=false;scene1Return=null;scene3SetMusicLevel(false);scene3Active=false;scene3MenuId=null;scene2SetMusicLevel(false);scene2Active=false;scene2FollowId=null;player={...center(32,28),dir:'up',step:0,moving:false,vx:0,vy:0,sprinting:false};camera.x=clamp(player.x-W/2,0,MW*TILE-W);camera.y=clamp(player.y-H/2,0,MH*TILE-H);setState('play');updateHUD();toast('Atalho de teste · A Grande Porta',3);};
  $('pause-scene2').onclick=()=>enterScene2();
  $('pause-scene3').onclick=()=>enterScene3();
  for(const q of LUMINI_QUESTIONS)$('lumini-question-'+q.key).onclick=()=>askLumini(q.key);
  $('lumini-questions-back').onclick=()=>setState('play');
  $('scene3-observe').onclick=()=>scene3Choose('1');$('scene3-research-a').onclick=()=>scene3Choose('2');$('scene3-research-b').onclick=()=>scene3Choose('3');$('scene3-cancel').onclick=()=>scene3Choose('4');
  $('scene2-listen').onclick=()=>scene2Choose('listen');$('scene2-lead').onclick=()=>scene2Choose('lead');$('scene2-cancel').onclick=()=>scene2Choose('cancel');
  $('game').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(scene1Active&&state==='play')scene1Click(e);else if(scene3Active&&state==='play')scene3Click(e);else if(scene2Active&&state==='play')scene2Click(e);});
  $('pause-restart').onclick=()=>retry(true);
  $('audio-toggle').onclick=toggleAudio;$('reset').onclick=()=>retry(true);$('fullscreen').onclick=()=>{$('viewport').requestFullscreen?.().catch(()=>{});};
  $('touchAction').onclick=interact;
  for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-move]')){
    let k={'up':'arrowup','down':'arrowdown','left':'arrowleft','right':'arrowright'}[b.dataset.move];
    const release=()=>heldKeys.delete(k);b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();b.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);heldKeys.add(k);});b.addEventListener('pointerup',release);b.addEventListener('pointercancel',release);
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown',onKeyDown);document.addEventListener('keyup',e=>heldKeys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()));
  window.addEventListener('blur',()=>heldKeys.clear());
  window.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>{if($('viewport').contains(e.target))e.preventDefault();});
  camera.x=clamp(player.x-W/2,0,MW*TILE-W);camera.y=clamp(player.y-H/2,0,MH*TILE-H);
  updateHUD();setState('start');requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
init();

</script>
</body>
</html>
